title: 第170章 冬眠第169章 龙族先知神秘白叔
content_zh:
紫霄领命而去，双翅一展，裹挟着雷霆之势冲出了结界。龙族结界之外，正是茅不易苦苦搜寻了一年的龙州大地。
紫霄循着那股污秽气息的残留痕迹，一路飞驰。它不愧是龙族中速度最快的雷龙，身形化作一道紫色的电光，在云层与山峦间穿梭。
而此时的茅不易，正沮丧地现出原形——一只巴掌大的黑色甲虫，六条细腿耷拉着，趴在一片枯叶上发呆。他找了一年的龙，只找到了蛇、蛇、还是蛇。心中的丧气如同黄昏的日头，一点一点沉下去。
“什么龙州，改名叫蛇州算了……”茅不易自言自语，触角无力地晃动。
忽然，一股磅礴的威压从天而降，伴随着隐隐的雷鸣。茅不易的复眼猛地亮起，翻身而起，六足紧扣地面。
“这是……龙威！”
他抬起头，只见一道紫色的闪电划破长空，正朝他所在的方向疾驰而来。那闪电的速度快得惊人，眨眼间便已逼近。这一次，茅不易看得真切——那是一条通体紫鳞、身长数十丈的巨龙，周身缠绕着噼啪作响的雷弧，双目如电，气势逼人。
“雷属性巨龙！是真正的龙！”茅不易激动得浑身发抖，差点从叶子上滚下去。他苦苦寻找一年，终于见到真龙了！
紫霄也发现了地面那个散发着污秽气息的小东西。它收拢双翅，缓缓降落，巨大的龙首低垂，一双雷光闪烁的眼睛死死盯着巴掌大的茅不易。
“就是你，在龙州释放污秽领域？”紫霄的声音如同闷雷，震得周围的树叶瑟瑟发抖。
茅不易连忙现出人类本体，拱手作揖，语气恭敬中带着难掩的激动：“这位龙君，在下茅不易，并非有意冒犯，只是寻找龙族已久，不得已才以领域探路。”
紫霄冷哼一声，龙须飘动：“龙州乃龙族栖居之地，不容外族肆意撒野。你寻龙族，所为何事？”
茅不易正要回答，忽然，天地间毫无征兆地剧烈震动起来。那震动并非来自地底，而是来自天空——准确地说，是来自天穹之上。
紫霄和茅不易同时抬头，只见原本湛蓝的天空，正以肉眼可见的速度变得灰白。一层诡异的冰蓝色从东方蔓延而来，所过之处，云层冻结成冰晶，纷纷坠落。阳光被遮蔽，气温骤降。
“这是……”紫霄瞳孔骤缩，龙躯不由自主地颤抖起来，不是因为恐惧，而是因为一种来自血脉深处的本能感应。
天地异变。
冰封之兆。
茅不易也感觉到了那股铺天盖地的寒意，那股寒意不像是普通的寒冷，更像是某种不可抗拒的天地规则——万灵沉眠，万物归寂。
紫霄猛地转头，朝着龙族结界的方向发出了一声震天的龙吟，那吟声中充满了惊骇与警示。但已经来不及了，冰蓝色的光芒以不可思议的速度席卷了整个龙州，大地、山川、河流、森林，一切都在瞬间被冰封。
茅不易只觉得自己的身体越来越僵硬，意识逐渐模糊。他在昏迷前的最后一刻，看见紫霄那庞大的龙躯也被冰层覆盖，如同一尊紫色的冰雕，盘踞在大地之上。

而在龙族结界之内，红莲刚刚冲出大殿，便迎面撞上了那股冰蓝色的光芒。她甚至来不及惊叫，便连同整个龙族一起，陷入了深深的冬眠。
天地之间，一片死寂。
只有漫天飘落的冰晶，在无声地诉说着这场异变的降临。
不知过了多久，茅不易悠悠醒来。他发现自己被冻结在一块透明的寒冰之中，六肢僵直，动弹不得。但奇怪的是，他的意识并没有完全沉睡，反而因为那股混沌炁体的特殊属性，在冰封中保持着微弱的清醒。
透过寒冰，他看见紫霄就趴在不远处，龙目紧闭，周身雷弧早已消散，被冻结在沉睡之中。
而在紫霄的身后，隐约可以看到一座巨大的、同样被冰封的结界——那是龙族的居所。
“这下好了……”茅不易在心中苦笑，“找了一年的龙，刚找到就全被冻住了。”
他想动，却动不了。想施展领域破冰，却发现寒气深入骨髓，连炁都无法流转。
天地异变仍在持续，冰封不知要持续多久。
而他，只能在这无尽的寒冷与寂静中，等待春天。
第一部，完。

content_en:
Zixiao took the order and left, spread his wings, and rushed out of the barrier with the power of thunder. Outside the dragon clan's barrier is the land of Longzhou that Mao Buyi has been searching for for a year.
Zixiao followed the remaining traces of the filthy aura and flew all the way. It is indeed the fastest thunder dragon among the dragons. Its body turns into a purple electric light and shuttles between the clouds and mountains.
At this time, Mao Buyi was frustrated and revealed his true form - a palm-sized black beetle with six thin legs hanging down, lying on a dead leaf in a daze. He searched for dragons for a year, but only found snakes, snakes, and snakes. The frustration in my heart is like the sun at dusk, sinking little by little.
"What is Longzhou? Let's just change its name to Snakezhou..." Mao Buyi muttered to himself, his tentacles swaying feebly.
Suddenly, a majestic pressure fell from the sky, accompanied by faint thunder. Mao Buyi's compound eyes suddenly lit up and he stood up, his six feet firmly attached to the ground.
"This is... Longwei!"
He raised his head and saw a purple lightning streaking across the sky, speeding towards his direction. The speed of the lightning was astonishingly fast, and it was approaching in the blink of an eye. This time, Mao Buyi saw it clearly - it was a giant dragon with purple scales all over its body and a length of dozens of feet. It was surrounded by crackling thunder arcs, its eyes were like lightning, and it was powerful.
"Thunder attribute dragon! It's a real dragon!" Mao Buyi was so excited that he trembled all over and almost rolled off the leaf. He searched hard for a year and finally saw the real dragon!
Zixiao also discovered the little thing on the ground that exuded a dirty smell. It folded its wings and landed slowly, its huge dragon head lowered, and a pair of lightning-flashing eyes staring at the palm-sized Mao Buyi.
"Is it you, releasing the filthy realm in Longzhou?" Zixiao's voice was like muffled thunder, making the surrounding leaves tremble.
Mao Buyi quickly appeared in his human form, bowed his hands, and said in a respectful tone with unconcealed excitement: "This Dragon Lord, I'm under Mao Buyi. I don't mean to offend, but I have been looking for the Dragon Clan for a long time, and I have no choice but to use my domain to explore the way."
Zixiao snorted coldly, and the dragon's beard fluttered: "Longzhou is the place where the Dragon Clan lives, and foreigners are not allowed to run wild. Why are you looking for the Dragon Clan?"
Mao Buyi was about to answer when suddenly, the heaven and earth shook violently without any warning. The vibration did not come from the ground, but from the sky - to be precise, it came from the sky.
Zixiao and Mao Buyi looked up at the same time, and saw that the originally blue sky was turning gray at a speed visible to the naked eye. A layer of strange icy blue spreads from the east. Wherever it passes, the clouds freeze into ice crystals and fall one after another. The sun is blocked and the temperature plummets.
"This is..." Zixiao's pupils shrank suddenly, and the dragon's body trembled involuntarily, not because of fear, but because of an instinctive feeling coming from the depths of his blood.
Changes in heaven and earth.
Sign of ice.
Mao Buyi also felt the overwhelming chill. The chill was not like ordinary cold, but more like some irresistible rule of heaven and earth - all souls fell asleep and all things returned to silence.
Zi Xiao turned his head suddenly and let out a thunderous dragon roar in the direction of the dragon barrier. The roar was full of horror and warning. But it was too late. The icy blue light swept across the entire Longzhou at an incredible speed. The land, mountains, rivers, and forests were all frozen in an instant.
Mao Buyi only felt that his body was getting stiffer and stiffer, and his consciousness was gradually blurring. At the last moment before he passed out, he saw Zi Xiao's huge dragon body also covered in ice, like a purple ice sculpture, entrenched on the earth.
Within the Dragon Clan barrier, Hong Lian had just rushed out of the hall when she ran into the icy blue light. She didn't even have time to scream before she, along with the entire dragon clan, fell into a deep hibernation.
There was deathly silence between heaven and earth.
Only the ice crystals falling all over the sky were silently telling the story of the coming change.
I don’t know how long it took, but Mao Buyi woke up leisurely.Come. He found himself frozen in a piece of transparent ice, his limbs stiff and unable to move. But the strange thing is that his consciousness is not completely asleep, but because of the special properties of the chaotic Qi body, he remains weakly awake in the ice.
Through the ice, he saw Zixiao lying not far away, her eyes closed tightly, the lightning arcs around her body had long since dissipated, and she was frozen in a deep sleep.
Behind Zi Xiao, a huge barrier that was also frozen could be vaguely seen - it was the residence of the Dragon Clan.
"It's good now..." Mao Buyi smiled bitterly in his heart, "The dragon that I have been looking for for a year was frozen as soon as I found it."
He wanted to move but couldn't. He wanted to use his domain to break the ice, but found that the cold air penetrated deep into his bones, and even his energy could not flow.
The changes in the world are still going on, and it is unknown how long the freeze will last.
And he can only wait for spring in this endless cold and silence.
Part one, finished.
